description: Double-shears symmetry, B(E2) plateau and J(2)/B(E2) ratio in 110Cd antimagnetic rotation

amr_criteria_evaluation.symmetry_principle: R_y(pi)*T discrete symmetry cancels the transverse magnetic dipole moments identically (mu_perp == 0), strictly forbidding Delta I = 1 M1 transitions.
amr_criteria_evaluation.be2_plateau: From 12+ to 20+, B(E2) remains nearly constant at 0.09-0.16 e^2b^2 (29-50 W.u.), falling to 0.069 e^2b^2 at 22+, because semi-rigid core rotation (Im_core ~ 19.5 hbar^2/MeV) slows the shears closing.
amr_criteria_evaluation.comparison_with_collective_rotor: Normal deformed collective rotation has J(2)/B(E2) ~ 15-40. AMR exceeds this by a factor of 4 to 10.
amr_criteria_evaluation.high_spin_22plus_branch_controversy: NNDC ENSDF adopted lists a 1100 keV transition with RI=37 and B(E2)=20(10) W.u. from 22+, but Roy 2011 coincidence gates failed to confirm this branch. Roy Table 1 is adopted with B(E2) = 0.06(2) (eb)^2 based on the clean 1314 keV gate.
